error.unknown_field: The form sent a field the server does not know. Reload the page.
error.missing_field: Title, prompt, agent view and recurrence are required.
error.bad_title: The title must be 1 to 500 characters.
error.bad_prompt: The prompt is empty or too long.
error.bad_harness: Pick a harness from the list.
error.bad_model: The model name is not valid (at most 128 characters).
error.bad_enabled: Enabled must be on or off.
error.bad_start: The start must be a local date and time.
error.bad_rule: The recurrence is not a valid RRULE.
error.too_frequent: The runs are too close together. Leave more minutes between them.
error.too_complex: The recurrence is too complex to check. Make it simpler.
error.too_far_back: The start is too far in the past. Move the start forward.
error.bad_timezone: The time zone is not known. Use an IANA name, such as Europe/Warsaw.
error.ended: The recurrence has ended. It does not fire again.
error.no_agent_view: The agent view of this schedule is gone. It does not fire.
error.no_view: You may not use that agent view.
error.view_fixed: The agent view is set at create. To move the schedule, delete it and create it again.
error.limit: You have reached the maximum number of schedules.
error.changed: The schedule changed meanwhile. Reload it and try again.
error.busy: The server is busy. Try again.
error.no_reach: The owner cannot reach the agent view of this schedule, so it cannot run.
error.overlap: The previous run has not ended yet.
error.too_soon: The schedule ran a short time ago. Try again later.
error.no_user: That user does not exist or is not active.
error.forbidden: You do not have the right to do this.
error.bad_uploads: The schedule has too many files. Remove some.
error.upload: The file could not be uploaded.
error.upload_gone: A file is no longer available. Remove it and attach it again.
